card: This pull request adds an optional control_block_warnings field to the decodepsbt RPC to flag taproot leaf control blocks that fail structural validation checks. Currently, decodepsbt reports taproot leaf records without indicating if their control blocks are unusable, and InferTaprootTree silently ignores invalid candidates during tree reconstruction without giving users diagnostic feedback. The change extracts existing validation checks from InferTaprootTree into a shared helper to report issues like mismatched Merkle roots or invalid leaf versions without altering signing behavior. The author cites consistency with merged PR 25513, which introduced similar diagnostics for taproot output trees. It has no open dependencies.
evidence: PR description: 'decodepsbt shows each PSBT_IN_TAP_LEAF_SCRIPT record as-is. It does not say whether its control block could be a genuine leaf of the input\'s taproot tree. InferTaprootTree() already checks this, but silently skips whatever fails... but it means a PSBT with an unusable leaf shows no sign of it.'
PR description notes precedent: 'Similar in spirit to #25513, which added the same kind of check for PSBT_OUT_TAP_TREE.'
problem: decodepsbt reports PSBT_IN_TAP_LEAF_SCRIPT records verbatim without indicating whether the control block is structurally valid or matches the input taproot tree. While InferTaprootTree already checks these conditions during tree reconstruction, it silently ignores invalid candidates, leaving developers and signers debugging malformed PSBTs with no visible diagnostics.

risk.why: A flaw in the extracted leaf checking logic could misidentify valid taproot leaves in InferTaprootTree or emit unexpected JSON fields that break external PSBT decoders.

scope_notes: The patch extracts inline leaf candidate checks from InferTaprootTree into a reusable helper in script/interpreter, adding an optional std::optional Merkle root parameter so decodepsbt can validate records when PSBT_IN_TAP_MERKLE_ROOT is absent.
summary: This pull request adds diagnostic warnings to the decodepsbt RPC when a taproot leaf control block is invalid. It refactors four structural leaf validation checks out of InferTaprootTree into a shared CheckTapLeafCandidate helper function in script/interpreter. When a control block fails any check, decodepsbt reports the error under a new control_block_warnings field in the input.
